title: Lamb Tagine with Thai Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic Thai-inspired lamb tagine made with the unique flavors of umami and algerian spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the umami, algerian, and salt, and cook for 1 minute.
Add 1 cup of water to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 hours, or until tender.
Stir in chopped cilantro and serve over rice or with naan.
